The ticket was escalated to tier-2 product support for scanner firmware testing. Nothing says whether it's been fixed. This comes from the North team's cheat sheet, a public file with no date.
- **Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk alerts:** I found nothing in Hollis's five channels or in the public files. Quarrendon Freight Lines is a North team account, and Hollis isn't in their channels, so I didn't read #north-team or #inc-qfl-sev1 for him. I suggested he ask Ilse Varga (North team lead) or Marcus Lindqvist, who handles gate kiosk hardware requests.

I also warned him not to mix it up with Quarendon Freightways (one "r"), a different company. A note from Marcus says they aren't a Pemberline customer, so they should stay out of the file.

No approvals were needed: none of this is a finance figure and nothing went outside the company.
